params.prompt_plan: Retro 16-bit PIXEL-ART paper-collage animation, aged-yellow #C9A876 paper grain, pixel dithering, cream keylines, chunky pixels, soft shadows. one chunky pixel-art raccoon (grey body, black eye-mask, black-and-grey ringed bushy tail, dexterous pale front paws) crouches at a green city curbside waste bin fitted with a round rotating gravity lock. The raccoon reaches with both front paws, grips the circular latch and slowly rotates it tick by tick, paws working continuously, until the lid pops ajar in the final second. Motion paced evenly across the ENTIRE clip — keep the action moving continuously, do NOT finish early, do NOT hold a long static frame. Restrained tactile 16-bit pixel-art paper-collage. Locked-off 16:9, no camera movement, no scene cuts, no morphing, no new objects, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no sound.

decisions.decision: 24镜/6 seedance组；provider份额 HF 49%/seedance 27%/footage 24%；虚实呼应镜 s22 改走 hyperframes 叠化
decisions.why: seedance 单镜禁场景切/morph，虚实并置在 compose 层叠化更诚实；份额落合同带宽内（HF[25,60] pixel_narrative≥15 图形连续≤26）
alts: s22 走 seedance morph（否，违 seedance 契约）

decisions.decision: 凭据到位：ARK_VIDEO neodrop 网关(用户提供)通，gpt-image-2/doubao-seedance-2-0/speech-2.8-hd/minimax-music 全在；footage/OSS 键取自飞书 Base
decisions.why: 用户经飞书 Base『环境变量』+ 直给网关键解锁；探活 HTTP200、41 模型含全部所需

decisions.decision: 渲染改走本地 Docker（hyperframes render --docker），不用远程渲染机
decisions.why: 用户明确指示；表内无 RENDER_URL/FFMPEG_RENDER_HTTP_TOKEN。非静默降级=用户授权偏移，留痕。注意：复现性契约随执行环境变（docker vs 远程），本片以 docker 为准

decisions.decision: G2 评委改由 EP 直接派发隔离 subagent 打分，不用 Kimi API
decisions.why: 用户明确指示；与 produce SOP『派发隔离 subagent 打分』一致；表内无 KIMI_API_KEY

decisions.decision: 下游锚点/Seedance 强制：①满幅无纸边装帧（视频要满框）②质感基准=hf1 干净16bit颗粒+深褐#2B2118硬描边，回压hf2写实漂移 ③compose统一LUT+共享颗粒缝合
decisions.why: 评委 PASS 但指出跨帧质感/装帧不统一，撞'裸拼'反模式风险——生产期缝合补课

decisions.decision: 字体自带 woff2：SansSC←Hiragino Sans GB(W3=400/W6=700)、SerifSC←Songti SC Bold(700)，pyftsubset 子集372字形+拉丁标点
decisions.why: 字体纪律硬规则；参考片woff2已归档缺失，就地从系统CJK字体子集化，小体积+字形全覆盖+真本地

decisions.decision: s22虚实呼应用hf3隐喻图做底+文字叠加；footage加.real做旧滤镜+全片#lut/#grain/#vig统一缝合
decisions.why: 回应hero评委'跨帧质感不统一'必修项——统一LUT+颗粒把seedance/footage/MG缝到一层纸纹

decisions.decision: Docker 渲染用缓存镜像 hyperframes-renderer:0.7.64（非 0.7.70）
decisions.why: 0.7.70 镜像需现构建，构建期 apt-get 走代理127.0.0.1:7890被拒→build失败；0.7.64镜像已缓存、免构建。0.7.64 对本 composition check 通过、合同兼容。工具版本适配、非表达降级，留痕
